# jobsafe

> jobsafe is a UK-based workplace incident reporting SaaS platform built for field service, construction, energy, logistics, manufacturing, and facilities management teams.

## What jobsafe does
jobsafe allows workers to capture safety incidents, near misses, hazards, and HSSE events from mobile devices — including offline. Reports include photos, video, voice notes, GPS location, and timestamps. Supervisors receive instant alerts. Every action is logged in an immutable audit trail.

## Key features
- One-tap mobile incident capture
- Works offline, syncs automatically
- Photo, video and voice attachments
- Auto GPS and timestamp on every report
- Real-time supervisor alerts
- Full immutable audit trail
- Dashboard analytics and pattern detection
- ISO 45001 and HSSE compliance aligned
- GDPR compliant, UK data residency

## Pricing
- Starter: £3.00 per licence/mo — up to 500 licences
- Professional: £2.50 per licence/mo — 500 to 1,000 licences
- Enterprise: Custom pricing — 1,000+ licences
- All plans include a 14-day free trial
- Annual billing saves 10%

## Industries served
Construction, Facilities Management, Manufacturing, Energy and Utilities, Logistics and Warehousing, Field Services
